caption:
Shopify Canvas is now in early access — and it changes how theme customization can be approached.

Canvas lets merchants view store templates side by side and work with Sidekick to create or change a theme from natural-language instructions. It also supports direct editing of blocks, settings, and text.

For developers, the interesting part is where the boundary now sits: simple visual changes can become easier, while custom architecture, app integrations, performance, accessibility, and complex theme logic still need proper engineering.

There are also important limitations right now: Canvas supports Shopify-developed and custom themes, but not third-party themes, and it currently has limitations around app blocks/embeds, translations, and Markets customization.

I’ll be watching how this fits into real production Shopify workflows as the feature matures.

Source: https://help.shopify.com/en/manual/online-store/themes/canvas
